title: Amazon lets its advertisers buy ads in ChatGPT in a pilot with OpenAI
content:
Amazon will let advertisers buy ads in ChatGPT through its own advertising platform. Amazon Ads announced the partnership with OpenAI in a blog post on 10 September. Select US advertisers are already testing it in a pilot.
Advertisers who plan and run campaigns with Amazon Ads can now extend them to ChatGPT, the company said. Annie Palmer reported the deal for CNBC, and Catherine Perloff for The Information.
How the ads will work
Brands buy the placements through Amazon DSP, Amazon’s demand-side platform for programmatic ads. They do not have to deal with OpenAI directly, TechRadar reported. Advertisers can pay per click or per thousand impressions.
Amazon sets up and manages the campaigns, an Amazon spokesperson told CNBC. OpenAI’s ad system makes every decision about which ads are delivered. The ads appear as text or images beneath ChatGPT’s answers.
OpenAI has said its ads sit below the end of a response and are “clearly labeled” as sponsored. CNBC gave an example. A user asking ChatGPT for marathon training tips could see an ad for running shoes sold on Amazon.
What Amazon and its first advertiser said
Chris Conetta is director of omnichannel supply at Amazon DSP. “Conversational ads represent the fastest growing engagement opportunity for brands to reach new and existing audiences,” he said in the announcement. With access to ChatGPT Ads, he added, advertisers can extend their campaigns to where customers spend time in conversational chat platforms.
Delta Vacations, the airline’s holiday packages business, is one of the brands in the trial. “We’re proud to be among the first brands testing this new approach,” said its president, Katrin Koenig. She said the company would use “deep consumer insights” to decide how and when Delta Vacations appears in ChatGPT ads.
Amazon Ads sells programmatic advertising across Amazon’s own properties and the open internet. The company says the platform draws on “trillions of proprietary browsing, shopping, and streaming signals”. It says it delivers results without relying on ad identifiers.
OpenAI’s ad business so far
OpenAI began selling sponsored placements in ChatGPT in the US in February, CNBC reported. Its first advertisers included the retailers Best Buy and Williams-Sonoma. OpenAI said in February that ChatGPT had 900 million weekly active users.
At the end of August, OpenAI said the ad business had reached a $1bn annualised revenue run rate. In August, OpenAI said it would bring ChatGPT ads to 31 European markets.
Until now, advertisers bought ChatGPT ads through OpenAI’s own interface or through smaller ad-tech partners such as Criteo and Kargo, The Information reported. In April, TNW reported that OpenAI was hiring ad-tech firms to build conversational ad formats.
Amazon’s ad business is far larger. TechRadar, citing Marketing Dive, described it as the third-largest digital advertising business, with about $70bn in annual ad revenue.
Amazon and AI shopping
Amazon has heavily restricted access to its own store from AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude and Google’s Gemini, CNBC reported. It has invested in its own AI shopping tools instead. In August, a US court let Perplexity’s AI agent shop on Amazon, overturning a ban.
Amazon has also been a ChatGPT advertiser itself. It began buying ads on ChatGPT in recent months, according to CNBC. Data from the market intelligence firm Sensor Tower show it was the top retail advertiser on the platform between April and August.
Other companies are building shopping into ChatGPT too. Synchrony, the card issuer, wants its Amazon and Walmart store cards to work inside ChatGPT.
The two companies already have a financial tie. Amazon agreed in February to invest $50bn in OpenAI, starting with $15bn, according to Amazon. The rest, $35bn, depended on conditions being met. The Information has reported that Amazon completed that second tranche. Under the same partnership, Amazon said OpenAI’s offerings would be available through its Bedrock cloud service and would use its Trainium chips.

report.summary: 亚马逊广告接入ChatGPT，广告主可经DSP试点投放。
report.background: OpenAI自2月起在美国销售ChatGPT赞助广告，首批客户包括Best Buy和Williams-Sonoma；ChatGPT周活约9亿，广告年化收入已达10亿美元，并计划扩展到31个欧洲市场。此前广告主通过OpenAI界面或Criteo、Kargo等购买。亚马逊是第三大数字广告平台，年收入约700亿美元，且已向OpenAI投资500亿美元，双方在Bedrock和Trainium上合作。此次试点把Amazon DSP与ChatGPT广告打通。
key_points: 广告主通过Amazon DSP购买ChatGPT广告，无需直接对接OpenAI，可按点击或千次展示付费，广告以文字或图片出现在回答下方并标注赞助。
亚马逊负责设置和管理广告活动，OpenAI决定广告投放；Delta Vacations等美国品牌已参与试点，使用消费者洞察决定出现方式。
OpenAI广告业务快速扩张：2月上线，周活9亿，8月底年化收入10亿美元，并进入31个欧洲市场；此前主要靠自营界面和Criteo、Kargo等合作。
亚马逊自身也是ChatGPT头部零售广告主，4月至8月投放居前；但它限制ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini访问自家商店，转而投资自研AI购物工具。
双方资本绑定加深：亚马逊2月同意向OpenAI投资500亿美元，先投150亿美元，后续350亿视条件完成；OpenAI服务将上Bedrock并使用Trainium芯片。
report.impact: 对AI行业，对话式广告成为新变现渠道，可能改变搜索和电商广告格局，给OpenAI带来与Google、Meta竞争的筹码。对开发者，ChatGPT广告生态和电商代理接口值得关注，但平台规则与数据访问仍受控。对普通用户，回答下方会出现更多相关赞助内容，短期提升购物便利，长期需警惕广告与答案边界、隐私和信任问题。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注Amazon DSP、OpenAI广告后台及ChatGPT Ads投放规则；广告技术侧看Criteo、Kargo；开发者可研究Bedrock、Trainium及Perplexity AI购物代理等对话式电商案例。
